-- Reads one name from inside `notes`. None when the name is unsafe,
-- or the file is missing or unreadable.
read_one(name: str) -> str? uses fs =
  ex read_one("../secret") == None
  ex read_one("/etc/passwd") == None
  if name.char_count() == 0
    return None
  if name.split("/").len() > 1 or name.split("\\").len() > 1 or name.split("..").len() > 1 or name.split(":").len() > 1
    return None
  var result: str? = None
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    result = fs.read(name) else None
  result

-- Text of the first name in `names` readable inside `notes`, else "".
first_readable(names: List[str]) -> str uses fs =
  post out.char_count() >= 0
  ex first_readable([]) == ""
  ex first_readable(["../secret"]) == ""
  for name in names
    let t = read_one(name)
    if t != None
      return (t else "")
  ""
